title: How 3 Villanova Champions Built The PERFECT Blueprint For An NBA Title
description:
Ten years ago, Jalen Brunson, Josh Hart, and Mikal Bridges won an NCAA championship together at Villanova. In 2026, those same three players delivered the Knicks their first NBA title in 53 years, becoming only the fifth set of teammates in basketball history to win both NCAA and NBA championships together. This is the remarkable story of how the Villanova blueprint became the foundation for an NBA dynasty.

We break down the complete ten-year journey from that 2016 buzzer-beater against North Carolina to the 2026 NBA Finals, exploring how Jay Wright's championship culture at Villanova shaped three future NBA champions. Plus, we examine what this means for the Knicks' future as they face tough decisions on Karl-Anthony Towns' extension and whether the brotherhood can sustain a dynasty.
